payload.name: Extract creative inspiration statements
payload.description: When a user explicitly states what inspired or influenced their creative work (script, book, movie, etc.), extract that fact into memory.
content: During candidate extraction, identify user statements that explicitly name an inspiration or influence for a creative project (e.g., 'sparked ideas for my next script', 'inspired by X').
Create a memory that links the creative project to the stated inspiration source, using a suitable memory type such as 'plan' or 'relationship' to preserve the fact.

solves: This addresses construction failures where explicit user statements about what inspired or influenced a creative project (e.g., a script, book, movie) are not extracted into memory, leaving later questions about the inspiration unanswered. The rule applies whenever a user directly names a source of inspiration for a creative work; it does not apply when inspiration must be inferred from implicit context.
